تشاتمت (form VI)
# تَشَاتَمْتُ (tašātamtu) /ta.ʃaː.tam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَاتَمَ (tašātama)
# تَشَاتَمْتَ (tašātamta) /ta.ʃaː.tam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَاتَمَ (tašātama)
# تَشَاتَمْتِ (tašātamti) /ta.ʃaː.tam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَاتَمَ (tašātama)
# تَشَاتَمَتْ (tašātamat) /ta.ʃaː.ta.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
